```r
[library](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)([tidyverse](https://tidyverse.tidyverse.org))
murders <- [read_csv](https://readr.tidyverse.org/reference/read_delim.html)("data/murders.csv")
murders <- murders |> [mutate](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/mutate.html)(region = [factor](https://rdrr.io/r/base/factor.html)(region),
 rate = total / population * 10⁵)
[save](https://rdrr.io/r/base/save.html)(murders, file = "rdas/murders.rda")
```
